### Burying Sins in the Sand
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/burying-sins-in-the-sand-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Exodus 2:11-12
Points:
- Moses acted on sudden human emotion and self-reliance rather than waiting for God's call and power.
- Taking matters into his own hands brought swift failure, fear, and an attempt to conceal his crime.
- People frequently try to bury their guilt, shame, and sin in the sand rather than dealing with them.
- Hiding our failures isolates us, but bringing them into the open invites God's redemptive healing.
- Unburdening ourselves through honest confession allows us to step into the life God intends for us.

### God Gets It Done
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-october-23-2023.html
Passage: Exodus 2:11-12
Points:
- Moses checked horizontally in both directions before killing the Egyptian, but forgot to look up toward God.
- Acting in the flesh forces us into cover-ups, lies, and messes that the sand will eventually reveal.
- Talented and qualified believers are especially prone to rushing ahead without seeking divine guidance and timing.
- While human schemes cannot even hide a single corpse, God easily accomplishes complete victory when He is in charge.
